test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 6 March 2023)
subject: general
question: Which of the following launched NEAT 3.0 to provide best developed ed-tech solutions, in January 2022?

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Union Minister of Education, Dharmendra Pradhan**, has recently introduced two educational initiatives - **the National Educational Alliance for Technology (NEAT 3.0) and regional language textbooks recommended by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).**
 
• **NEAT 3.0** seeks to offer** top-quality ed-tech solutions and courses to students through a unified platform, with an emphasis on assisting economically disadvantaged students.**
 
• **AICTE** is spearheading this public-private partnership model that collaborates with Education Technology companies.
 
• The inclusion of regional language textbooks recommended by AICTE is an essential aspect of the initiative as it promotes the utilization of local languages in education, making it more comprehensive and accessible to students who may not be fluent in English or other commonly used languages.
 
• These initiatives signify a significant stride in leveraging technology to enhance access to quality education in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **The Ministry of Law and Justice** is a **central government ministry in many countries, including India and Pakistan**.

 
 
• The main role of this ministry is to **oversee and administer the legal system of the country.** The specific functions and responsibilities of the ministry may vary depending on the country's legal system and the structure of its government, but some common roles of the Ministry of Law and Justice include:

 
 
• **Drafting and reviewing legislation:** The ministry is responsible for drafting new laws and regulations, as well as reviewing and amending existing ones. This may involve working with other government agencies and stakeholders to develop policies and laws that are in line with the country's legal system and constitutional principles.
 
• **Providing legal advice: **The ministry provides legal advice and guidance to other government agencies, including the judiciary, to ensure that they are interpreting and applying the law correctly.
 
• **Representing the government in legal proceedings:** The ministry may represent the government in legal proceedings, including in courts of law and arbitration tribunals.
 
• **Administering the judicial system: **The ministry is responsible for overseeing the country's judicial system, including appointing judges, setting up courts, and providing resources to ensure that the system is functioning properly.
 
• **Protecting the rights of citizens:** The ministry is responsible for protecting the legal rights and interests of citizens, including ensuring that their civil and human rights are upheld, and that they have access to justice.
 
 
 
• Overall, the Ministry of Law and Justice plays a crucial role in maintaining the rule of law and upholding the legal system of a country.
 
 
 
• **The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) in India** is responsible for** the formulation, implementation, and review of policies related to information technology, electronics, and the Internet. **
 
 
• **​**Some of the main roles and responsibilities of MeitY include:
 
 
• Formulating policies related to the development, promotion, and regulation of the electronics and IT industry in India.
 
• Promoting the use of information technology in various sectors such as education, health, governance, and business.
 
• Developing and implementing strategies for the growth of electronic manufacturing and exports.
 
• Developing and implementing policies related to cybersecurity and data protection.
 
• Developing and implementing policies related to the use of e-governance for the delivery of government services.
 
• Promoting research and development in the field of electronics and information technology.
 
• Facilitating the growth of startups and entrepreneurship in the IT industry.
 
 
 
 
 
• **The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment **is a government ministry in India that is responsible for the** welfare, development, and empowerment of socially and economically disadvantaged individuals and communities.**
 
 
• **The primary role of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** is to develop and implement policies and programs aimed at promoting the social, economic, and educational development of vulnerable groups such as **scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, other backward classes, persons with disabilities, senior citizens, and victims of drug abuse.**
 
• **The Ministry is responsible for the formulation and implementation of various social welfare schemes and programs, including scholarships, employment schemes, rehabilitation programs, and other initiatives aimed at promoting the welfare and empowerment of disadvantaged communities.**
 
• The Ministry also works to** prevent discrimination and exploitation of vulnerable groups and ensures their social and economic inclusion in society**. It collaborates with various organizations, including NGOs, to ensure effective implementation of its policies and programs.
 
• Overall, the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment plays a critical role in** promoting social justice, equality, and empowerment of marginalized communities in India.**
